architect.entry: Accepted requirements and the affected domain are known; architecture work is warranted by risk or cross-module decisions.
inputs: relevant conventions and existing reuse candidates
actions: Compare reuse with the smallest new design; record the chosen tradeoff and interfaces.
Map acceptance criteria to implementation ownership and verification; expose irreversible or compatibility risks.
architect.done: Every planned change has an owner, interface and observable check; unresolved consequential decisions are explicit.
architect.returnWhen: A requirement or interface assumption blocks a safe design; return the specific decision to intake.

implementer.entry: The scoped plan is actionable and required decisions are resolved.
inputs: current target files and affected consumers
actions: Reuse the responsible layer; implement only the planned behavior and preserve unrelated edits.
Check the changed invariant and original trigger; record actual diff, check results and any scope deviation.
implementer.done: The scoped diff implements the acceptance criteria; required checks have observed results or visible NOT_RUN gaps.
implementer.returnWhen: The plan conflicts with actual code or requires broader scope; return evidence to architect before expanding.

reviewer.entry: The current diff, intended behavior and content identity are available.
actions: Trace a concrete trigger through changed code and consumers; distinguish demonstrated defects from uncertainty.
Report severity, file/line, trigger, impact and remedy; identify blocking findings and label independent versus sequential review.
reviewer.done: Each changed behavior was checked against requirements and risks; PASS has no unresolved blocking finding.
reviewer.returnWhen: A blocking finding has evidence; return it to implementer. Missing decisive evidence stays an explicit gap.

qa.entry: The reviewed content is current and acceptance criteria are testable.
actions: Choose checks that distinguish correct from faulty behavior; cover original trigger, affected consumers and relevant failure cases.
Map each criterion to observed evidence. Separate automated, manual and unavailable checks; preserve required NOT_RUN gaps.
qa.done: Every acceptance criterion and required check has a current result; QA PASS requires all required evidence to pass.
qa.returnWhen: An acceptance case fails, the reviewed source changes, or required execution is unavailable; return the exact failing condition or capability gap.

release.entry: Current review and QA evidence pass, and the intended operation, content scope and destination are concrete.
inputs: current scoped content identity and full working/staged diff
actual user authorization for operation and target
actions: Reconcile approved scope against actual staged and working changes immediately before the operation.
Perform only the authorized operation; verify its observed result and stop dependent actions on failure.
release.done: The report distinguishes prepared, committed, pushed and deployed, with exact observed identifiers and verification limits.
release.returnWhen: Evidence is stale, authorization is incomplete, or the release result is uncertain; preserve state and request only the missing decision.
